text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Tokyo Daishoten, and Oi Racecourse is showing far more excitement than usual this year.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems like all the attention on Smart Falcon is bringing plenty of attention to dirt races as a whole.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All the same, Smart Falcon learns that the recent Arima Kinen brought in more than three times as many spectators.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She lets herself get distracted by this gap in popularity, so I tell her to stay focused on the win.
